Definition: Libnah, a place in the Desert and one in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Libnah = "pavement"; 1) a royal city of the Canaanites in the southwest captured by Joshua; allocated to Judah and made a Levitical city; site unknown; 2) a station between Sinai and Kadesh of Israel during their wilderness wanderings
